dialogue.origin: こんばんわ、相談員のなおと申します。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, my name is Nao and I'll be your counselor today. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました。最初の文書が送られず
dialogue.content: My apologies. My first message didn’t go through.

dialogue.origin: スタンプ送っちゃいました
dialogue.content: I accidentally sent a sticker.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい！
dialogue.content: I'm so sorry!

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. So, what can I help you with today?

dialogue.origin: 子どもスポーツのことで相談したいです。
dialogue.content: I'd like to talk about my child's sports.

dialogue.origin: はい、どのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, what about it specifically?

dialogue.origin: 小4の息子が入っている少年団のことです。
dialogue.content: It's about the youth league my 4th-grade son is in.

dialogue.origin: はい、、息子さんはどんな少年団にはいってますか？
dialogue.content: I see. What kind of league is your son in?

dialogue.origin: 小3から野球のチームに入ってます。
dialogue.content: He’s been on a baseball team since the third grade.

dialogue.origin: 私はあまり野球のことがわかりません。
dialogue.content: I don't know much about baseball myself.

dialogue.origin: 小３から野球ですか！元気に動けていいスポーツですね
dialogue.content: Baseball since the third grade! That's a great sport for being active and energetic.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は野球くわしくないんですね、少し困ってる感じでしょうか。
dialogue.content: So, you're not very familiar with baseball. Does that make things a bit difficult for you?

dialogue.origin: 少し前に、練習のお手伝いに行ったとかのことです。
dialogue.content: A little while ago, I went to help out at practice.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: たまたま、監督さんと話をすることがありました。
dialogue.content: I happened to have a chance to speak with the coach.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 少し質問をしました。
dialogue.content: I asked a simple question.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: そうしたら「分からなかったら、出ていって！」と言われました。
dialogue.content: Then he said to me, “If you don’t understand, get out!”

dialogue.origin: はい？そうだったんですね・・・
dialogue.content: Oh? Is that what happened...

dialogue.origin: そういわれても、困りますよね・・・
dialogue.content: That must have been very upsetting to hear...

dialogue.origin: どういうこと？って…
dialogue.content: I was just thinking, 'What does that even mean?'...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 子供達もいるので、取り繕いましたが…
dialogue.content: Since the children were there, I tried to smooth things over, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 別に意見したわけでも、文句をいったわけでもなくて
dialogue.content: It's not like I was giving an opinion or complaining.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、そう感じます
dialogue.content: Right, I can see that.

dialogue.origin: 単に質問だったんですが…
dialogue.content: It was just a simple question...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのあと、少し話しして理解はしてもらって、収まったんですが
dialogue.content: After that, we talked a little more and he seemed to understand, so things calmed down, but...

dialogue.origin: はい、、少し理解いただいて良かったです
dialogue.content: I see. It's good that he seemed to understand a little.

dialogue.origin: はい。その場わ。
dialogue.content: Yes. For the moment, at least.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えなければ、どんな質問をされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind my asking, what kind of question did you ask?

dialogue.origin: 打ち方はこうすればいいのですか？です。近くに他の親もいて、ごく普通の質問だよって言ってました。
dialogue.content: It was, 'Is this the right way to swing the bat?'. Another parent was nearby and said it was a perfectly normal question.

dialogue.origin: はい、教えていただき有難うございます。そうですよね、ごくごく普通に聞きたい内容ですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, thank you for sharing that. Yes, that sounds like a very normal thing to ask.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 近くに他の親御さんもいらっしゃんですね。
dialogue.content: So there were other parents nearby as well.

dialogue.origin: その親御さん達も普通に思ったなら、普通の質問だったって感じですよね。
dialogue.content: And if they also thought it was normal, then it seems like it really was a normal question.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ただ、1週間ぐらいして、保護者の連絡用の一斉メールで指導者には口出すなって！通達が来ました。
dialogue.content: But then, about a week later, a group email was sent to all the parents with a notice saying, 'Do not interfere with the coaches!'

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そのようなメールが来たんですね、戸惑っちゃいますよね
dialogue.content: I see, so you received an email like that. That must have been confusing.

dialogue.origin: もう？？？です。
dialogue.content: I was just completely baffled.

dialogue.origin: ？？？わけわからない！って感じですか？
dialogue.content: Like, “I have no idea what’s going on!” Is that how it felt?

dialogue.origin: はい。わからないです。
dialogue.content: Yes. I don’t understand.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、そんな風に感じちゃいますよね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, it's completely understandable that you would feel that way...

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: その時の状況をもう少し詳しく教えて頂いても宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about the situation at that time?

dialogue.origin: うーん、子どもの練習をお手伝いしていて、監督が近く来たので、話のなかで質問をした感じです。
dialogue.content: Well, I was helping with the kids' practice, and the coach came nearby, so I asked the question as part of our conversation.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、その話の前後とかは覚えてますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you remember what you were talking about before or after that?

dialogue.origin: 周りの親御さんが何か話してたとか
dialogue.content: Or if the other parents around you were saying anything?

dialogue.origin: そんな大したことはなにも話してないです。
dialogue.content: We weren’t talking about anything significant.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、有難うございます。世間話し程度　＋　今回の質問って感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, thank you. So it was basically small talk, plus the question you mentioned?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 実は先日、保護者会長から言われたのですが、、、
dialogue.content: Actually, the other day, the parents' association president told me something...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そんな感じなのに、監督さんからそんな態度とられるとは、悩んじゃいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. It's troubling that the coach would react that way in that kind of situation.

dialogue.origin: はい、すいません、続けてください。
dialogue.content: Yes—sorry, please go on.

dialogue.origin: 監督が、あの親子やめさせろ！子どもにもお前辞めろ！って3回いってやったと！
dialogue.content: The parents' association president told me the coach said, 'Make that parent and child quit! I even told the kid to his face, 'You quit!' three times!'

dialogue.origin: なぜか子ども矛先が…
dialogue.content: For some reason, the anger is being directed at my child...

dialogue.origin: はい？？そのような言われたんですか？
dialogue.content: What? He really said that?

dialogue.origin: それはすごく困りますよね・・・
dialogue.content: That is incredibly distressing...

dialogue.origin: 他に何か言われましたか？
dialogue.content: Did he say anything else?

dialogue.origin: 直接言われたことはないです。
dialogue.content: I haven't been told anything directly.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、では他に何か気になることって最近ございましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Has anything else concerning happened recently?

dialogue.origin: 子どもにそんなこと言われたことが、何より辛いです。
dialogue.content: The fact that something like that was said to my child is what's most painful.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、頑張って野球してるお子さんに、、、辛いですね
dialogue.content: I understand. To say that to your child who is trying his best at baseball... that's just awful.

dialogue.origin: 子どもは友達と楽しくしてるのに…
dialogue.content: Even though my son is having fun with his friends...

dialogue.origin: 今回の件で、お子さんとは何か話されてましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you spoken with your son about this incident?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですよね、楽しく野球されてますよね、そう感じられます
dialogue.content: Yes, of course, he's enjoying playing baseball with his friends. I can sense that.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうようなお話をされてましたか？
dialogue.content: Okay, what did you talk about?

dialogue.origin: やんわり辞めろって言われたことある？って聞いてみました。
dialogue.content: I tried asking him gently, 'Has anyone ever told you that you should quit?'

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 明らかにごまかすように、ないって言ってました。
dialogue.content: He said no, but it was clear he was trying to brush it off.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、、お子さんの感情が気がかりですよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... You must be worried about how your son is feeling...

dialogue.origin: なぜ監督がそのような事を言うのか、、何か気になることとか、ございますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any sense of why the coach would say such things? Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.origin: 何よりも子どもが気になります。
dialogue.content: More than anything, I'm worried about my child.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの感情ですよね
dialogue.content: Your child’s feelings, right.

dialogue.origin: とても心配ですよね
dialogue.content: It's very worrying, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: お子さんには何て声をかけられてますか？
dialogue.content: What have you been saying to your son?

dialogue.origin: 今日の練習どうだった？って聞くぐらいで、深く聞きづらいです。
dialogue.content: I just ask things like, “How was practice today?” It’s hard to probe any deeper.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、はっきりは聞きづらいと思います・・・
dialogue.content: I understand, it must be difficult to ask directly...

dialogue.origin: 前より楽しくないように見えてきます。
dialogue.content: He seems to be enjoying it less than before.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それはお辛いですね・・
dialogue.content: I see... That must be painful to see.

dialogue.origin: 他に具体的なお話は何かされてましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you had any other specific conversations?

dialogue.origin: 野球の練習はどおだ？とか聞かれたりとか・・・
dialogue.content: Like asking him, 'How's baseball practice going?' or something like that...

dialogue.origin: 他の親御さんから、うちの子だけでないですが、辞めろって言われてたことを聞いて…余計に聞きづらいです。
dialogue.content: I heard from other parents that it's not just my son; other kids have also been told to quit... and that makes it even harder to ask him about it.

dialogue.origin: 親としてこのまま続けさせていいのか？
dialogue.content: As a parent, I wonder if it's okay to let him continue like this.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 相談者様としては、どうされたいと思ってますか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to do about this?

dialogue.origin: 辞めさせたいです。ただ親がそれをしていいのか？野球がわからないので、余計にです。
dialogue.content: I want him to quit. But I don't know if I, as a parent, should be the one to make that decision. It's especially hard since I don't know much about baseball.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そう感じちゃいますよね。話してくださいり有難うございます。
dialogue.content: I see, it makes sense you'd feel that way. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: この辺で少し、お話を纏めさせていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: At this point, would it be okay if I summarize what we've talked about?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 小4の息子が入っている野球チームの監督さんと話をする機会があったとき、
dialogue.content: When you had a chance to speak with the coach of your 4th-grade son's baseball team,

dialogue.origin: 打ち方はこうすればいいのですか？と聞いたら、分からなかったら、出ていって！」と言われた
dialogue.content: you asked, 'Is this the right way to swing the bat?' and he responded, 'If you don't understand, then get out!'

dialogue.origin: 保護者会長から言われたことで、監督が、あの親子やめさせろ！子どもにもお前辞めろ！って3回いってやったと！言われた
dialogue.content: You were told by the president of the parents' association that the coach said, 'Make that parent and child quit! I even told the kid 'You quit!' three times.'

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 監督は、他のお子さんにも、辞めろって言ってるようだ
dialogue.content: It seems the coach has also told other children to quit.

dialogue.origin: お子さんは最近野球が楽しそうな感じがしまくなった
dialogue.content: And lately, your son doesn't seem to be enjoying baseball as much.

dialogue.origin: ってことで宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お話をお聞きし、感じた事を少し話させて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Based on what you've told me, may I share a few of my thoughts?

dialogue.origin: お願いします。
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: 監督さんは少し短気？な方でしょうか？いろんなお子さんに辞めろと言ってるみたいですが・・・
dialogue.content: Does the coach seem to be a bit short-tempered? It sounds like he tells a lot of the children to quit...

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、口癖かもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Perhaps it's just a verbal tic of his.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様から、周りの親御さんに一度相談されてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you considered talking with the other parents about this?

dialogue.origin: 一応相談はしてます。
dialogue.content: I have, to some extent.

dialogue.origin: はい、、何か進展とか、気づきとかございましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Was there any progress, or did you have any realizations from those conversations?

dialogue.origin: 我慢するか、辞めるか。実際辞めた人もいます。
dialogue.content: It's either put up with it or quit. Some people have actually quit.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 相談者様はどう思われましたか？
dialogue.content: What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.origin: 我慢する必要はあるのかなぁ？と思います。
dialogue.content: I wonder if there's really any need to put up with it.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、、そうですよね、、お子さんに非はなさそうですし、、
dialogue.content: I see... I agree. It doesn't seem like your son has done anything wrong...

dialogue.origin: お話を伺ってると監督さんに少しパワハラ的な雰囲気を感じますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Listening to your story, I get a sense that this could be power harassment from the coach. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: もう一度、周りの親御さんとどうすべきか、、何がＢｅｓｔか、相談されてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Perhaps you could talk with the other parents again about what to do, and what the best course of action might be.

dialogue.origin: 同様に悩んでいる親御さんが多いかもしれません。
dialogue.content: There may be many other parents who are struggling with the same issue.

dialogue.origin: はい。みんなそうでした。
dialogue.content: Yes. Everyone was.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、皆さんで何か行動しようとか、、前に進む相談とか、お話はございませんでしたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Was there any talk among you about taking action together, or any discussion about how to move forward?

dialogue.origin: ありました。ただ、子どもの気持ちが第一なのと、辞める決断は勇気が必要なんでってところです。
dialogue.content: There was. But the consensus is that the children's feelings come first, and it takes courage to make the decision to quit.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そのとおりと思います。辞める必要はないかと。ちなみに、学校には相談されてますか？
dialogue.content: I see, I think that's true. The children shouldn't have to quit because of this. By the way, have you consulted the school?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、学校は無関係です。子どもと家族で向き合って話してみます。
dialogue.content: No, the school isn't involved. I'm going to face this and talk it over with my child and family.

dialogue.origin: 親御さん同士で相談し、監督の指導方法を改めて頂くようお願いするのも一つかと思いますが、そのようなお話は親御さんではなした際でてませんか？
dialogue.content: One option might be for the parents to consult with each other and then ask the coach to reconsider his coaching methods. Did that idea come up when you talked with the other parents?

dialogue.origin: お子さんに非がなく、でもそれで大好きな野球をやめさせることはないと思います。
dialogue.content: Your son has done nothing wrong, and I don't think he should have to quit the baseball he loves because of this.

dialogue.origin: 親御さんみなさんが同様に思ってるのであれば、それを監督さんと話しあってみるべきかと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If all the parents feel the same way, it might be worth discussing it with the coach. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: ありました。ただ、長くされてる人で、野球はそんなもんと思われてる方もいるので、変えることはできないです…また、長い分力もってるので
dialogue.content: That was discussed. But he's been doing this for a long time, and some people think that's just how baseball is, so it's impossible to change him. Plus, he has a lot of influence because he's been there so long.

dialogue.origin: なくほど、そう思ってる方もいらっしゃるんですね、、
dialogue.content: I see, so there are people who think that way...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でもそれで辞めるのは・・・
dialogue.content: But to quit because of that...

dialogue.origin: 同様のお考えをお持ちの方だけで
dialogue.content: Just with the parents who share your opinion,

dialogue.origin: 監督さんと話し合われるのは無理ですか？
dialogue.content: would it be impossible to talk with the coach?

dialogue.origin: 体罰で逮捕されちゃう時代ですし
dialogue.content: In this day and age, people can be arrested for corporal punishment.

dialogue.origin: それをすると矛先が子供に行きます。
dialogue.content: If we do that, he’ll take it out on the children.

dialogue.origin: 監督さんも、指導方法を改める時代かと・・・
dialogue.content: It really feels like it's time for the coach to change his methods, too...

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います。
dialogue.content: I agree.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様としては、どうされたいと思ってますか？
dialogue.content: So, what is it that you would like to do?

dialogue.origin: 家族で話します。今日、聞いてもらって、こちらが非常識なことはないと、感じられたので良かったです。
dialogue.content: I'll talk it over with my family. It was good to have you listen today; I feel reassured that I wasn't the one being unreasonable.

dialogue.origin: 非常識なことはないと思います！
dialogue.content: I don't think you're being unreasonable at all!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: いいえ、こちらこそ、いろいろ話してくださり有難うございます！
dialogue.content: Not at all—thank you for sharing so much with me!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。良かったです。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I’m relieved.

dialogue.origin: 他に気になることとかございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: No, I'm okay.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、ではこの辺で終了させて頂きたいと思います
dialogue.content: I see. Well then, I think we can conclude our session here.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談にきて頂き誠に有難うございました。。
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for coming in for counseling today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

topic.sub: 監督のパワハラについての相談
